title.narrative: Capacity of constituents to take action to promote and realize fundamental principles and rights at work is strengthened

description.narrative: ILO will continue to support the implementation of FPRW in Türkiye under 2 main programmes; “Elimination of Child Labour” and “Strengthening Social Partners and Civil Society Capacities on Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work”. Within the scope of child labour, the overall objective of ILO’s interventions is to contribute elimination of worst forms of child labour (WFCL) in seasonal agriculture in line with the Government’s strategy. ILO will support the promotion of fundamental principles and rights at work through empowering social partners (SPs) and civil society organizations (CSOs) along with facilitating their adaptation in the changing world of work.
